additions.credit_rule: Additional to the 120-hour baseline: Moore 2h, Mackie 4h, integration/fresh/delayed checks 2h. Hume/Ayer/Thomson baseline work preserved; existing Hume/Ayer reading log reused without another full reading charge.

C06 charges 8 added hours. The same lecture/context and retained R33 reconstruction may receive 4 hours credit within C12C Module 5 (22 baseline hours), leaving 18 hours of new comparative work there. Credit is conditional on compatible complete lecture scope and satisfactory retained evidence. Mairet evidence does not verify Macomber wording; C12C must recheck cited wording and context in its assigned Macomber edition within the remaining 18 hours. Do not credit 8 hours or bill the shared 4 hours twice.

evidence: R33 reconstruction with source locators and feedback

limitations: Not learner-piloted, human-expert-validated, tutor-calibrated, rights-cleared or visually/accessibility-tested.
Ayer second-edition chapter VI and Van Norden 2008 2A6/6A1–10 were not inspected; exact textual diagnoses remain source-dependent.
Preferred modern-edition quotation/page checks for Irwin 2019, Gregor–Timmermann 2012, Sher 2001 and SBN/Nidditch 1978 require actual copies; public witnesses are not relabeled.
Mackie exact section selection established from university-hosted scan; lawful learner access and source availability still required, with affected judgments provisional if absent.
Mairet web lecture inspected in selected spans, not collated against print. Macomber 2007 bibliographic/context metadata checked only; later wording/context check required.

final_delayed_check.timing: roughly 4–6 weeks after course completion or after two later modules
